initial_audit_events.title: DATASET INGESTED (REAL SOURCES)
initial_audit_events.details: Ingested Bengaluru Central Pilot: OpenStreetMap (OSM) Vector Layers & Karnataka SSLR Cadastral Reference (3 Parcels, 3 Buildings, 15 Levels)

initial_audit_events.title: CRS REPROJECTED (EPSG:32643)
initial_audit_events.details: Transformed WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) coordinates to UTM Zone 43N (EPSG:32643) metric grid for sub-meter cadastral calculations

initial_audit_events.title: PARCEL-BUILDING ASSOCIATED
initial_audit_events.details: Computed 100% polygon containment for Building B01 within Cadastral Parcel KA-BLR-SY-42-1 via Shapely geometric engine

initial_audit_events.title: VERTICAL LEVELS STRATIFIED
initial_audit_events.details: Stratified 12 vertical levels for B01 via Height-Based Level Estimation (H/3.5m); Ground datum anchored at 921.5m MSL via SRTM 30m (Open Topo Data)

initial_audit_events.title: 10-RULE TOPOLOGY VALIDATION EXECUTED
initial_audit_events.details: Evaluated 10 geometric rules. Parcel KA-BLR-SY-42-1 flagged for Human Review (Estimated Vertical Levels). Parcel KA-BLR-SY-14-2 flagged for Cantilever Boundary Overhang (QA Test Case).
